name: p01-clean-proof
description: Clean replay-lab proof panel for the two correctness-gap candidates that survived the no-brain difficulty screen: the durable-facts merge-confidence default (value-recovery) and the export checkpoint-branch-reachability contract (behavioral). One pinned Codex runner, no_brain vs full_brain, four repetitions. Tasks are checkpoint-backed entire-brain history tasks (no sibling repos needed). The other two authored clean tasks (order-cache, value-hook) are intentionally excluded: order-cache saturated (no_brain solves from the symptom) and value-hook's brain arm raised quality but did not recover the exact value.
